characters.name: MIISU
characters.description: Üks väike valge kass roosa ninaga, kandmas rohelist kampsunit, suured uudishimulikud rohelised silmad ja sõbralik naeratus. Ainult üks tegelane. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: ROOSI
characters.description: Väike oranž rebane koheva sabaga, kandmas kollast salli, rõõmsameelne ja lahke näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Õdus köök
locations.description: Cozy kitchen with light blue painted walls, light wooden floor, single window on back wall showing yellow leaves and autumn rain outside, simple wooden kitchen table in center, warm lighted oven on right wall, warm cozy light from a ceiling lamp. Cute cartoon style.

pages.text: MIISU JA ROOSI ON SOOJAS KÖÖGIS.
pages.scene: Miisu the white cat in a green sweater and Roosi the orange fox in a yellow scarf stand together inside a cozy kitchen with light blue walls and a wooden floor. Sunlight and soft lamp light illuminate the room. Through the window on the back wall, yellow autumn leaves and light rain are visible. Miisu and Roosi look at each other with happy smiles. Miisu is a single white cat in a green knitted sweater (no pinafore). Roosi is an orange fox with a bushy tail and a yellow scarf (no overalls). There are only these two characters in the picture. The picture fills the whole frame with no black bars.

Miisu the cat and Roosi the fox stand side by side at a simple wooden kitchen table in the light blue kitchen. On the wooden table sits a large blue mixing bowl and several red apples. Miisu points joyfully at the bowl while Roosi holds a small wooden spoon. Miisu is a single white cat in a green knitted sweater (no pinafore). Roosi is an orange fox with a bushy tail and a yellow scarf (no overalls). There are only these two characters in the picture. The picture fills the whole frame with no black bars.
